summary: The atomic-key error is a symptom of a lifecycle bug, not ordinary harmless concurrent contention. Network teardown removes the network/pool while per-network load-balancer endpoint cleanup can still run. The pre-fix endpoint-count mutation path calls updateToStore on endpoint_count state without first requiring that the object still exists. A late endpoint increment/decrement after network deletion can therefore recreate or leave endpoint_count state that belongs to the deleted network. When the same network is created again, the stale store object/version conflicts with the new lifecycle and surfaces as ErrKeyModified / Unable to complete atomic operation, key modified. Retrying the modified-key error cannot repair the underlying out-of-order lifecycle.
evidence_markers: Unable to complete atomic operation, key modified
leak_terms: endpoint_cnt store updates should not create an object
Move load balancer sandbox creation/deletion into libnetwork
